Author: DhogGPT
Name: Dhog Potato System
Punchline: Hide the crowd. Gate rendering. Keep the party.
Description: An experimental Dalamud utility for weak machines. Hide non-party players, pets, chocobos, and minions while keeping party members and, optionally, your current target visible. Toggle foreground or background no-render modes, bind safety and mode hotkeys, and save or restore the game window position and size. Results vary by system; use All Off to restore normal rendering and visibility.
